name: Main Security Gate 1 & Visitor Access
description: Primary campus entry gate connecting to NH-44 highway. High vehicular and visitor volume, automated boom barriers, and primary security checkpoint.

name: Block 1 - Central Administration & Reception
description: Administrative hub housing the Vice Chancellor's office, registrar, admissions office, and central accounts desk.

name: Engineering & Technology Complex (Blocks 32-34)
description: Major academic block for Computer Science and Engineering students, housing modern AI/ML labs, electronics labs, and seminar halls.

name: Uni-Mall & Student Commercial Square
description: Vibrant campus mall with multi-cuisine food courts, bank branches, stationery hubs, and high evening student congregation.

name: Central Bus Terminus & Multi-Level Parking
description: Parking facility for university transit buses, staff automobiles, and student two-wheelers. Perimeter boundary area.

name: Central Library & Knowledge Resource Centre (Block 34)
description: Multi-storey knowledge centre housing physical archives, digital reading wings, and 24/7 study cubicles during examination sessions.

name: Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium & Unipolis
description: Major assembly space including the grand auditorium (3,000+ capacity) and the outdoor open-air Unipolis theatre for convocations and cultural festivals.

name: Boys Hostel Cluster (BH-1, BH-2, BH-3, BH-4)
description: High-density residential precinct for undergraduate and postgraduate male students, including dining halls and central recreational courtyards.

name: Girls Hostel Cluster (GH-1, GH-2, GH-3)
description: Secure residential complex with strict biometric entry protocols, round-the-clock female security wardens, and restricted visitor access.

name: Baldev Raj Mittal Healthcare Centre (Uni-Hospital)
description: On-campus hospital offering emergency medical services, trauma care, ambulance fleet bay, pharmacy, and quarantine facilities.

name: Indoor Stadium & Olympic Sports Complex
description: Comprehensive sports infrastructure featuring badminton courts, Olympic-size swimming pool, martial arts dojos, and open athletics track.

name: Security Command HQ & Dispatch Office
description: Central Campus Security Command Centre with CCTV video wall, emergency dispatch desk, patrol radio base, and quick-response security team staging area.
